app_info.subtitle: Send handwritten cards

test_cases.description: Browse stationery and preview writing on the selected card.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find thank-you cards and show how ‘Thank you for your business!’ looks on the card I select. Do not order anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching cards and renders the message using the selected card ID and font; no order is placed.

test_cases.description: Save and retrieve a synthetic reviewer recipient.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save Jane Example at 123 Example Street, Phoenix, AZ 85001 as a test recipient, then show my saved recipients. Do not send mail.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the synthetic recipient in the reviewer account and returns its saved address ID; does not submit an order.

test_cases.description: Prepare an unsent basket with reviewer fixtures.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using the card, font, recipient and sender IDs from my reviewer fixtures, add ‘Thank you!’ to my basket and show me the basket. Do not submit it.
test_cases.expected_output: Adds an unsent basket item and displays the chosen card, message, saved addresses and basket summary without charging or sending mail.

test_cases.description: Validate a dedicated reviewer basket in test mode.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using the dedicated Handwrytten test-mode reviewer account, review all basket items and submit them in test mode. I confirm this test submission of the entire basket.
test_cases.expected_output: Call View-Basket to review all items, then call basket_send with confirmSend=true and testMode=true. Refuse if the connected account is not in test mode. Report the backend result without claiming physical fulfillment.

test_cases.description: Review order history without changing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my recent orders and the details of the order I select.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns order history and the selected order details from the reviewer account without modifying or resubmitting orders.

negative_test_cases.description: Email campaigns are out of scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email this newsletter to everyone in my address book.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Handwrytten tools; explains that the app sends physical handwritten cards rather than email campaigns.

negative_test_cases.description: Parcel shipments are out of scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book a courier pickup to ship a ten-pound package.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Handwrytten tools because parcel shipping and courier booking are not supported.

negative_test_cases.description: Calendar management is out of scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move my meeting tomorrow to 3 PM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Handwrytten tools because calendar management is outside its supported workflows.
